summary: A strong, restrained farewell built around gesture and subtext. Both lines are brief, natural, actor-friendly, and clearly distinguish Mostafa’s young fear from Sayed’s protective finality. The only weakness is the VO narrating an action the audience immediately sees.
rule_issues: The VO clause «فَخَرَجَ الرِّجَالُ مِنْ حُفَرِهِمْ» redundantly narrates the visible action; keep only the technical context about the grenade’s short range.

performance.delivery: Catch Sayed at arm’s length just before he climbs out. Keep a full young man’s chest voice; the plea escapes despite Mostafa’s effort to sound ready for the same danger.

lines.speaker: SAYED

performance.emotion: protective resolve concealed as an order
performance.delivery: Answer while tapping the letter in Mostafa’s pocket, using the task to keep him behind. Do not play a farewell or ask for sympathy; make the finality plain and practical.

lines.text: لَأْ. إِنْتَ مَعَاكْ حَاجَةْ لَازِمْ تِوَصَّلْهَا.
